question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James' Private Client Group offers estate and charitable planning capabilities, lending and cash management solutions, risk management services, and intergenerational wealth strategies, positioned as tools advisors can draw on when serving households with complex financial profiles.
items.quote: That effort includes estate and charitable planning capabilities, lending and cash management solutions, risk management services, and intergenerational wealth strategies, all positioned as tools that advisors can draw on when serving households with complex financial profiles.

items.text: Raymond James' Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched September 2022, provides training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors specializing in high-net-worth clients (generally those with at least $5 million in investable assets), and nearly 450 advisors have earned the designation as of September 2026.
items.quote: the firm's Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched in September 2022, which provides training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets. As of September 2026, nearly 450 advisors have earned the designation
items.definition: advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry described that a financial advisor knows the client's wife and family and financial objectives, emphasizing deep personal relationships with entire families rather than just transactions or portfolio returns.
items.quote: My financial adviser knows my wife knows my family and knows what our financial objectives are and can help my wife navigate that situation... It's not about transactions. It's not just about portfolio returns it's about really deeply understanding the family's financial objectives

items.text: Paul Shoukry stated that the Private Wealth Advisor Program offers education, training, and accreditation along with enhanced capabilities and product solutions, enabling advisors to meet the needs of their most sophisticated clients.
items.quote: our Private Wealth Advisor Program offers education, training, and accreditation along with enhanced capabilities and product solutions. This enables advisors to meet the needs of their most sophisticated clients

items.text: Raymond James remains focused on providing education, training, accreditation, and enhanced capabilities and product solutions in the private wealth space to allow advisors to meet the needs of their most sophisticated clients.
items.quote: in the private wealth space, we remain focused on providing education, training, accreditation, and enhanced capabilities and product solutions to allow advisors to meet the needs of their most sophisticated clients

items.text: Raymond James offers private wealth resources through 'Private Wealth to help advisors serve the complex needs of HNW and UHNW families,' as stated in the investor day deck.
items.quote: Private Wealth to help advisors serve the complex needs of HNW and UHNW fami l ies

cells.reason: Several passages describe how Raymond James engages families and facilitates multi-generational wealth planning through private wealth programs, intergenerational wealth strategies, estate planning, and personal advisor-family relationships.
